name: Batik
description: Wax-resist batik: dark six-petal flowers on a pale ground crazed all over with fine dark cracks, where the dye ran into the split wax.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -50%; top: 49.5%; width: 200%; height: 1%; background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); opacity: .6; -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-30, 30)%, @r(-40, 40)%) rotate(@r(0, 180)deg); transform: translate(@r(-30, 30)%, @r(-40, 40)%) rotate(@r(0, 180)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 9%; top: 9%; width: 82%; height: 82%; z-index: 1; background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--flower); clip-path: @var(--flower); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(13% 13% at 50% 50%, transparent 98%, #000 100%); mask: radial-gradient(13% 13% at 50% 50%, transparent 98%, #000 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --flower: @shape(split: 180; r: .66 + .34 * abs(cos(3t)); scale: .96); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
